reason: A web-composer utility that adds capability-aware reasoning choices and provider-native Fast or priority request controls without changing the selected model or provider.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web Composer 提供按模型能力匹配的推理档位，以及不更换模型或提供商的原生 Fast 或优先级请求控制。
summaries.en: Adds capability-aware reasoning profiles and provider-native Fast or priority request controls to the DeepSeek Harness web composer without changing the selected model or provider.

capabilities: Adds reasoning effort profiles and selector options in the web composer
Adds a provider-native Fast mode toggle
Modifies outbound model request parameters for supported provider and model routes
Validates provider, model, and API matches and rejects unsupported routes
